text.description_html:
Baldwin Estates Collection Nashville Knobset with 5010 Rosette, Baldwin 5068/50105002

The classic design of this 2-3/8 inch diameter knob allows it to look beautiful in almost any setting. Concealed mounting means that the sleek look is not interrupted by unsightly screws; and because it is made by Baldwin out of solid brass, you know that it is made with attention to both style and quality. This knobset will fit 1-3/8 inch and 1-3/4 inch door thicknesses with an optional backset for 2-3/8 inches or 2-3/4 inches.

Features of the Baldwin 5000 Classic Knobset:

  • Concealed mounting to hide unsightly installation screws.
  • Forged from solid brass for maximum strength and durability.
  • 28 degree latch rotation
  • Heavy duty latch bolts springs.
  • Latches are reversible for all door conditions.
  • Latches include standard full lip strike.

Specifications of the Nashville Knob:

  • Rose Diameter: 2" - will NOT cover standard 2-1/8" bore
  • Knob Diameter: 2-3/8"
  • Overall Projection: 2-7/16"
  • Backset: choose either 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"
  • Door Thickness: adjustable for 1-3/8" and 1-3/4"

When Selecting a Function:

  • Half Dummy: A surfaced mounted, non-working, smooth knob. Non-locking and non-latching trim for one side of door. This inactive pull is usually used to match trim.
  • Full Dummy: A surfaced mounted, non-working, smooth knob. Non-locking and non-latching trim for both sides of door. These inactive pulls are usually used to match trim.
  • Passage (hall or closet): Latches but does not lock. The latch is activated by turning the either of the two knobs.
